<threat_model>
## Trust Boundaries

| Boundary | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| operator-shell → meta-repo planning docs | Wave A edits .planning/v1.6-EVIDENCE.md + .planning/v1.5-BENCH-RESULTS.md inside the meta-repo working tree; no external input crosses. |
| operator-shell → sub-repo build toolchain | `pio run -e <env>` consumes firestarter/platformio.ini and the v1.6-read-bug source tree; produces .hex artifacts in `.pio/build/`. No external input. |
| operator-shell → host CLI install | `pip install -e .` resolves dependencies from `pyproject.toml` against the local Python env. Deps already cached from Phase 26 install. |

## STRIDE Threat Register

| Threat ID | Category | Component | Disposition | Mitigation Plan |
|-----------|----------|-----------|-------------|-----------------|
| T-29-01-01 | Spoofing | sub-repo branch tip drift between research (2026-05-22) and Wave A execution | mitigate | Task 1 verifies `git rev-parse --short=8 HEAD` matches `4f205e58` (firestarter) and `c057fe2` prefix (firestarter_app); HALT-and-surface on mismatch (per Task 1 action step 1). |
| T-29-01-02 | Tampering | `pip install -e .` pulls compromised dependency | accept | All deps (pyserial, requests, tqdm, argcomplete, rich, packaging) already cached from Phase 26 install; editable install re-resolves only the local package; no network registry fetch expected. Low severity — operator's already-trusted Phase 26 install state. |
| T-29-01-03 | Information Disclosure | EVIDENCE.md commits leak secrets | accept | Standard meta-repo convention: only commit .planning/*.md text files. No `.env` / `.secret` files in scope. The build-hash record stores SHA-256s + commit SHAs only, no credentials. |
| T-29-01-04 | Repudiation | Build-hash record cannot prove which commit produced the hex | mitigate | Task 4 records `4f205e58` source-commit column verbatim alongside each SHA-256; combination of commit SHA + hex SHA-256 is unambiguous (RESEARCH Pitfall 4). |
| T-29-01-05 | Tampering | working-tree drift in `firestarter_app/firestarter/config.py` produces unintended runtime behavior in editable install | mitigate | Task 1 surfaces the `git diff` to task summary; Task 3 pytest gate (`tests/test_consistency_check.py -x`) catches functional regression. Disposition deferred to operator if diff is non-trivial — recorded as "surface and proceed" per RESEARCH Open Q1. |

**Severity assessment:** All threats LOW. Phase 29 has no novel security surface (RESEARCH §"Security Domain"); no network exposure; no authentication surface; SHA-256 use is stdlib (Python hashlib, coreutils sha256sum/shasum). ASVS L1 controls: V5 partial (CLI arg validation inherits from Phase 26); V6 partial (crypto consumed, not implemented).

**Block on high-severity:** N/A — no high-severity threats identified.
</threat_model>
